caption: Ninemate’s · Codex’s five hours at 3%: the bar’s Usage button with its count of warnings not seen. The review already moved to Claude Code; the card says nothing of it.
Ninemate’s · the open coordinator’s Talk room: the warning at its foot, in red, saying 5% (the threshold crossed, though 3% is left), with Open usage and Seen.
Ninemate’s · ⌘U, several accounts: the usage view, a modal over the window: every account, every window, its source and age, Read again.
Ninemate’s · ⌘U, agents with no reading: each is an account with a fault, “No usage source”, said three times.
Ninemate’s (and every direction) · the task: Althar’s line in the thread, as the app shows its other runtime notices; the review runs on Sonnet 5.5.
Every direction · the project waits for resets: the line, the held card being built now (which says it again), and the header: “The review waits for Codex until 14:00”.
Ninemate’s · Claude Code Work’s week gone, the work moved to Codex: the notice still says 5% left; the card shows the new lead only.
A · plenty left everywhere: one faint glyph beside the load meter, a place to click and for ⌘U to open from; no words, no count.
A · Codex’s five hours at 3%: the chip names only the tightest limit, in ink as deep as it is low; the card says where the review went and why.
A · the chip (or ⌘U) opens a popover, not a page: agents and accounts tightest first, each window a slim bar, the agents with no reading in one calm line.
A · Claude Code Work’s week gone: “Claude Code · out · until Mon 09:00”.
A · the Talk room’s card, beside its lead: “Went to Codex · Claude Code is out until Mon 09:00”. No notices.
A · several accounts: another of Codex’s has room, so the review stays on Codex, on Side, whatever the rule.
B · the task’s model picker: each model says what its route has left (Opus counts its own week), or “no reading”.
B · under a tenth left, a model’s chip says so: on the plan’s Review step, and on the coordinator’s own composer (it runs on GPT-5.5). Nothing in the bar.
B · the card shows the model the review went to, marked as moved; why, on hover, in the thread’s words.
B · several accounts: a model’s route is its agent’s account with most room, named: Codex’s go on Side, 79% left (its week).
B · Claude Code Work’s week gone: its models say “out · until Mon 09:00”; the work runs on GPT-5.5 now.
C · the home: a quiet Plan usage section under what needs you, a line per agent. No warning anywhere while nothing is out.
C · an account out and work held for it (the project waits): it shows in Needs you; the agents with no reading in one line.
C · Settings › Agents › Codex: under each account, every window, where the numbers came from and how old.
C · an agent with no reading: said calmly, in words, under its account.
C (and every direction) · the project waits for resets: the card says “Waiting for Codex until 14:00”. Codex isn’t out, so nothing needs you.
C · Claude Code Work out, the work held for it: Needs you, with a way to carry on now on another model.
